 for the applicant.
Shri Aps Tomar, Public Prosecutor for State.

Shri Rajiv Sharma, learned counsel for the respondent/
 Order

This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of B.N.S.S. for grant of interim bail relating to Crime No.12/2024 registered at Police Station - Porsa, District - Morena (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 304-B, 498A & 34 of IPC and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant / accused argued that younder brother of applicant is getting married on 9.12.2024.
Therefore, he has to make necessary arrangements for marriage and he wants to attend the marriage of younger brother of applicant.
Hence, prayed to release the applicant on interim bail.

On the other hand,
learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary.

In view of the documents filed by the applicant, present application is allowed and it is directed that applicant be released on Ankit Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41205609/
1 temporary bail for a period of five days i.e. from 6.12.2024 to 10.12.2024 on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
Applicant is directed to surrender before the trial Court/Committal Court on or before 11.12.2024.
During the period of temporary bail, applicant is directed not to visit in the vicinity of the prosecution witnesses related to this case.
